killedBy: forced-colors.mjs: the seams no vitest run can execute installs the AudioContext override before each pass navigates
why: Leaves the two real `AudioContext`s the app builds at boot -- Howler's, when `createAudioEngine` first touches `Howler.volume()`, and `engine.ts`'s `ensureCtx`. On a host whose audio service never connects each constructor returns only after an internal 20-second timeout, so the page blocks for ~40 s before `load` fires and every forced-colors pass builds its own page, so the stall is paid once per (scheme, forced) combination rather than once per run.
